results.title: Fantastic Flowers
results.overview: Fantastic Flowers is a compilation of short silent films produced between 1906 and 1920, displaying amazing colours that were applied to each frame using the Pathécolor process, or other similar stencilling techniques. Bonsoir – La Fée aux fleurs (1906) / [Bloemenvelden Haarlem] (1909) / Les Chrysanthèmes (1907) / Le Chrysanthème, roi de l’automne (1914) / [Les Tulipes] (1907) / Les Fleurs dans les jardins (1914) / L’Après-midi d’une japonaise (1920) / The Beauty Thief ([1920]) / La Fée printemps (1906) / [Het schoonste uit de natuur] (1912?) / La Culture du dahlia (1911) / [Hollandse Tulpen en Klompen] (1920?) / Fabrication des fleurs artificielles (1911) / [Bonsoir tableau] (1906)

results.title: The Dino Family
results.overview: The life of a schoolboy Filipp Dinozavrov is full of failures, but one day he opens a portal to the Mesozoic era.

results.title: Открытие
results.overview: Five aspiring directors, five short stories about the discovery of cinema. Each short story is an independent story exploring how cinema begins, how it influences us and where the line between the screen and reality lies. The film almanac has the widest range of genres, themes, geography of authors, time of action and even frame format. It can be a short sketch from the set, where the lighting technician suddenly changes places and importance with the most influential auteur director; preparation for the first film screening in Rus'; a conversation between friends immediately after the film; a story of a difficult choice between creative freedom and a career; and finally, a free interpretation of the 1986 film about the life of a simple fisherman from Kaliningrad.

results.title: The Confection
results.overview: What if your friend died in the stupidest way possible?

results.title: Belén
results.overview: In the conservative northwestern region of Argentina, Julieta finds herself accused of infanticide after a medical emergency. With support from her attorney and women's rights advocates, she fights for justice in a landmark case that could change lives.

results.title: Harvest Brood
results.overview: In October 2006, the community of Briar, Alabama was terrorized by a series of gruesome killings. This film is an account of the horrors that unfolded during that fateful autumn.

results.title: Truth Untold
results.overview: A cynical podcaster claiming to be seeking "truth and justice" for a 20 year old crime interviews a former suspect and quickly finds herself in over her head.

results.title: Reckoning Day
results.overview: Wu Qing Qing, the young master of the Wolong Gang, has been betrayed after her family's massacre. From prey to hunter, she transforms into a hunter. Hidden in the shadows, behind every smile may lie a deadly dagger. A Japanese trading company infiltrates her inner circle, a mole is hidden among her closest relatives, and a web of intrigue unfolds. Trust is a luxury; every step is a precipice! How will she tear off those masks of hypocrisy? Is the traitor a member of the gang, an invading enemy, or even her own husband?  The storm has arrived; "eliminating the traitor" becomes the only creed…

results.title: Kiss
results.overview: A musician is gifted with the supernatural ability to see a couple's destiny whenever they kiss. But when he sees the grim fate of the woman he loves, he must use his powers to defy destiny itself.

results.title: Tenung
results.overview: Ira lives with her mother, Linda. One day, without any rational explanation, a mystical incident causes Linda to behave like a madwoman—suffering physically and frequently hallucinating. Unable to cope with her mother's condition, Ira asks her siblings, Ara and Ari, to come home and help take care of their mother. Unfortunately, fate has other plans, and Linda eventually passes away.

results.title: 32B
results.overview: The film presents a dramatic human story about a father separated from his wife who tries to maintain a close relationship with his teenage daughter amidst awkward and volatile parenting situations.

results.title: Ky Nam Inn
results.overview: Set in 1985 post-war Vietnam, Khang moves to Saigon after securing a position to translate "The Little Prince." Due to his family connections, Khang's life under the new regime is secure. But everything changes when he meets Ky Nam, a reserved older widow who lives in Khang's new community.

results.title: Whistle
results.overview: At the Masters of Musical Whistling competition, where virtuoso whistlers compete for global supremacy and bragging rights, we follow an array of quirky personalities and dazzling talents in a film sure to be a crowd-pleaser.

results.title: Christmas Snowed in with a Prince
results.original_title: Christmas Snowed in with a Prince
results.overview: During a freak blizzard, a remote British lodge is shut down with just two guests: Ellie, a sarcastic travel blogger, and a handsome, overly polite guest who's definitely not from around here. Turns out, he's Prince Alaric, stranded while trying to escape royal duties. With only each other and no Wi-Fi, sparks (and snowballs) fly.

results.title: Alice in Wonderland –Dive in Wonderland–
results.original_title: 不思議の国でアリスと –Dive in Wonderland–
results.overview: The main character is a modern girl named Rise. One day, she wanders into Wonderland, and when she meets Alice, the story begins to unfold.

results.title: Mommy's Boys
results.overview: Adrian Hughes digs into his mother's dramatic life, from the jetset Copenhagen of the 1950's to loneliness and alcoholism, but a bitter farewell letter opens new wounds. In Jesper Dalgaard's staged documentary we encounter tragic female destinies, affluent and absent fathers, while actors such as Birthe Neumann, Asta August and Jakob Cedergren bring the past to life in this breathtaking experiment. With equal parts humour and pain, the film shows that it's never too late to try to understand your family.

results.title: Last Culprit
results.overview: Five outlaws are invited to a remote mansion for a game organized by a crime writer (Mr. Lewis) with an eccentric heir (Adam) as his secret partner who provides the funding for the game. But things aren't what they seem.

results.title: Never Alone
results.overview: 1942. The State of Finland has formed an alliance with Nazi Germany. An elderly man single-handedly tries to stop a secret attempt by the Finnish State Police to hand over Jewish refugees directly to the Gestapo.
